or sin(delta) plus a periodic penalty (correlated ones, since virgil#174)</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-documented" id="D6"><span class="vt-fid">D6</span> <span class="vt-badge">documented</span><div>With unequal closure-phase errors in a group, fouriever uses r^T C^+ r and virgil r^T D^-1/2 R^+ D^-1/2 r (different generalised inverses of the singular C)</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div></div><h3>Problems found in other packages (7)</h3><div class="vt-findings"><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P1"><span class="vt-fid">P1</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>PMOIRED setupFit(auto=True) gives NaN models on files with few channels</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P2"><span class="vt-fid">P2</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>PMOIRED&#x27;s default ring sampling is not its documented Nr = 100</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P3"><span class="vt-fid">P3</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>PMOIRED&#x27;s rings stop at ~1e-4 precision beyond 30 samples per baseline</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P4"><span class="vt-fid">P4</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>CANDID&#x27;s Absil detection limits are ~1 % low against its own criterion (bracketing by factors of 1.4, then linear interpolation)</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-raised" id="P5"><span class="vt-fid">P5</span> <span class="vt-badge">raised</span><div>fouriever&#x27;s closure-phase residual is not wrapped, so data straddling +-180 deg give a ~2 pi residual at the true parameters</div><div class="vt-muted"><a href="https://github.com/kammerje/fouriever/issues/26">fouriever#26</a></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P6"><span class="vt-fid">P6</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>eht-imaging&#x27;s Obsdata.tlist/bllist return tuples under NumPy 2 when every time group has the same size, so closure phases fail</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div><div class="vt-finding vt-f-to-raise" id="P7"><span class="vt-fid">P7</span> <span class="vt-badge">to-raise</span><div>orbitize! adds the fitted gamma to companion RVs when primary RVs are present, though its docs say companion RVs are relative to the barycentre</div><div class="vt-muted"></div></div></div><h3>Mistakes in our own checks (1)</h3><div class="vt-findings"><div class="vt-finding vt-f-fixed" id="C1"><span class="vt-fid">C1</span> <span class="vt-badge">fixed</span><div>Our PMOIRED parameter mapping had the wrong sign of d(ratio)/d(incl)</div><div class="vt-muted"><a href="https://github.com/benjaminpope/virgil-validation/pull/11">virgil-validation#11</a></div></div></div>
